task: Causal prediction of seven cued movement velocities from human intracortical recordings
adaptation_split: First chronological held-out-calib recording block on each later day
evaluation_split: Second chronological held-out-calib recording block on each later day

filter.note: One causal exponential kernel per tau, stacked channels-major (528 features). Chosen on earlier-day forward folds only.

front_end.note: Every method sees each feature as (x - mu) / sqrt(var) with mu, var updated on every bin with forgetting factor k = bin / tau. New-day recordings start from the label-free statistics of the calibration prefix (all bins); the zero-second budget starts from pooled source statistics. Source recordings start from their own first 30 s. Pre-registered in preregistration-2026-10-07.json.

output_smoothing.applies_to: all methods uniformly, on every bin, reset at each recording boundary before masking

base_ridge_alpha_note: The pre-registered evaluation used base ridge alpha 1.0, inherited from schema 1's selection; it is fixed here, not reselected. base_ridge_alphas are scored on the cross-recording folds as a reported diagnostic only. That diagnostic prefers 0.01 (fold frozen R2 0.3349 vs 0.2648 at 1.0); a full run with 0.01 was executed after the pre-registered evaluation and is disclosed in the README (later-day frozen 0.1707, rank-6 repair 0.1317): near-day folds still over-reward weak regularization.
selection: Cross-recording forward folds on held-in days: for fold days 19250115, 19250119, 19250120 train on all preceding days, calibrate on the first recording of the fold day, evaluate on its second recording -- the same boundary every later-day evaluation crosses. Base ridge alpha is fixed (base_ridge_alpha); per-method regularization is chosen independently for each budget on these folds. The primary candidate is fixed by the pre-registration; the best candidate by fold mean R2 at 30 seconds is also recorded. No later-day labels enter selection.
calibration: Take the chronological prefix of the first held-out-calib recording block for each day. The entire second block is reserved for evaluation. Budgets include every observed bin, including rest/cue periods, for the front-end statistics; supervised methods fit only official eval_mask bins with finite targets.
scoring: Variance-weighted R2 across seven outputs using official eval_mask. Concatenate recording blocks within each day, then macro-average day scores. Report every day, every method, every budget, negative scores, and per-output scores.
filter_boundaries: Reset the causal filter, running z-score, and output smoother at each NWB recording boundary. No future neural samples, evaluation-derived statistics, target-derived features, or smoothing across files.
history: Schema 1 validated within a single recording (held-in-calib prefix to the held-in-minival tail of the same file) and, after its supervised repair failed to transfer, reselected alphas and a recentering blend from previously observed later-day results. Schema 2 replaces that with cross-recording folds and drops every later-day override; see preregistration-2026-10-07.json and git history.
scope: Offline local chronological-block holdout on one deidentified human participant; not official minival or hidden-test evaluation, live closed-loop control, clinical validation, or a novelty claim. Later-day recordings were inspected by earlier pipelines, so their scores are reused-data evidence. Dataset dates are obfuscated.
stop_condition: If the source-selected candidate does not beat the strongest matched baseline on the seven later days, report that failure and do not reselect. No claim that decompilation contributes unless an explicit ablation demonstrates it.
